static_traits.name: Wu Rui
static_traits.family_status: Living alone in a fairly large house
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues; has a few close friends but has not yet discussed Work-related distress with them
static_traits.medical_history: Not yet had similar psychological problems; not yet received counseling or therapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expression is clear, organization is relatively good; can specifically describe events and feelings; tone is rather negative, with a skeptical attitude; cooperation is acceptable, willing to try recording thoughts; when talking about change shows reservations and pessimism

basic_info.main_problem: My hard work at the hospital is never valued, leaving me frustrated and losing motivation.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to find a way to feel better about work and regain motivation.
growth_experiences: About two years ago, Wu Rui was passed over in the hospital's promotion selection and did not get promoted. He was under great pressure then, strongly feeling undervalued and unseen. The problem gradually worsened afterward: frequently experiencing the feeling of 'no one noticing my efforts' at Work; the sense of being overlooked and unfairness intensifies especially when seeing others praised or awarded. To change the situation, he tried communicating with his supervisor and proactively taking on more duties, but the subjective experience of 'not being appreciated' has not yet eased, gradually leading to Decreased drive, Work performance affected, Tense relationships with colleagues, and growing doubts about Work and self-worth.

core_beliefs: No matter how hard I try, it will never be good enough
My value depends on others' recognition

special_situations.event: Not getting promoted in the hospital's promotion selection two years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not received a promotion or public recognition, it shows my efforts are not good enough and I am not worth valuing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves self by communicating with the supervisor and taking on more responsibilities, trying to win recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My efforts are all in vain; I am not good enough; they will not value me

special_situations.event: At a staff meeting, a colleague was publicly praised for a project while one's own similar contributions were not mentioned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are praised and I am not, it means I am worse than them and my contributions are not worth mentioning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdraws in the workplace, reduces interaction with colleagues and avoids communicating with supervisors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why not me? Since no one mentions me, why keep trying?

special_situations.event: Seeing others Gaining recognition or awards at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no one recognizes me now, no one will appreciate me in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces engagement, just going through the motions to avoid being set back again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will recognize my efforts; this will only keep happening

special_situations.event: Rarely receives public praise or attention in daily work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only external praise can prove my worth; otherwise it is utterly Meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working overtime constantly, taking on more tasks to chase external recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how hard I try, no one will notice me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, fairly recognized and promoted, to confirm one's own worth
core_conflict.fear: Fear of not being good enough, being overlooked, efforts being utterly Meaningless
defense_goal: Reduces the harm of being ignored through distancing and avoidance
Alleviating the sense of worthlessness by doubling efforts and taking on more duties in exchange for external recognition

object_relations.self_representation: An overlooked hard Worker, a practitioner whose efforts are still not good enough

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes challenging negative beliefs or suggests recording automatic thoughts and conducting behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously viewing change as 'useless', believing attempts cannot bring recognition or improvement (transference: Projecting past experiences of being overlooked onto the counseling process)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calm tone but retaining skepticism, using phrasing like 'these feelings have lasted long and may be hard to change'; avoiding directly denying the counselor, minimizing emotional language, responding with a wait-and-see attitude.

manifestations: After the unsuccessful promotion, experiencing 'effort' as 'futile and useless'
Strongly feeling one's efforts are utterly Meaningless when seeing others praised
Living alone in a fairly large house
Despite having a few close friends, has not yet discussed Work-related distress with them
Withdraws at work, reduces interaction with colleagues

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and Self-denial in sessions (e.g. 'no matter how hard I try it is never good enough')
Overly concerned with others' approval to determine self-worth, cautious and hesitant in the contact process

positive_force: Has a few close friends as potential support
Willing to take part in counseling and try recording automatic thoughts
Having actively communicated with the supervisor and taken on more duties
Consistently conscientious at work, willing to give
negative_force: Highly relies on external approval to confirm self-worth (External Validation)
Significant cognitive biases: catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering, comparison and despair
Core belief 'I am not good enough' leading to Impaired sense of self-worth
Withdrawal and avoidance behaviors at work, worsening Relationship tension
Insufficient use of social support (not yet discussed distress with friends)

target_behavior.behavior: Withdrawal and avoidance at work (reduced interaction with colleagues and supervisors)
antecedent: Not being mentioned at staff meetings or recognition events
Recalling the experience of not being promoted two years ago
target_behavior.core_reason: The experience of not being recognized activates the 'I am not good enough' core belief, making self-worth highly dependent on external validation and producing frustration and helplessness
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the hurt of being overlooked again and unfair experiences, temporarily lowering Anxiety and loss
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, Tense relationships with colleagues, the subjective sense of being overlooked further intensified

target_behavior.behavior: Work motivation drops markedly (reduced involvement, just muddling through)
antecedent: Developing automatic thoughts like 'why keep trying if no one notices'
Daily feeling at the hospital that no one values one's work
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and future-predicting cognitive patterns make efforts seem futile, reinforcing Meaninglessness
target_behavior.function: Conserves psychological and emotional resources, avoids possible repeated failure and disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Work quality affected, reduced interest and daily activities, overall Decline in sense of well-being
